# `get_img_file`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Fetch an image from the device starting at a transfer offset.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit imager build: conditional diagnostics; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | D |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0x1f5a60 (64-bit imager build); offset and length clamp in the file-server result writer |

Served by the imager process (4801). Params select a file by name and an optional offset. The reply is the file data from the offset as a binary transfer, or a text error. The offset and length are clamped to the file; an offset past the end gives a reply with payload length 0, not an error (READ). The unit is bytes (INFERRED). Path normalisation and FITS loader effects are unresolved.

Side effects: Writes native diagnostic output. Further file, image, database and compression effects are unresolved (tier D).

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"get_img_file"`. [READ] |
| `params` | object\|array | no | - | File name and offset, as an object or as a positional array [name, offset]. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 105 | name missing or not a string | `expected string param` |
| 249 | Image load failure (exact condition unresolved) | `malloc buffer failed` |

## Example

Request, object-form:

```json
{"id":43,"method":"get_img_file","params":{"name":"example.fit","offset":0}}
```

Request, array-form:

```json
{"id":44,"method":"get_img_file","params":["example.fit"]}
```
